items.title: Agentic-RAG-Engine
items.subtitle: Multi-Agent RAG Platform for Deep Technical Knowledge
items.challenge: Conventional RAG systems fail with hallucinations or incomplete context when querying complex, multi-source technical documents and enterprise repositories.
items.solution: Multi-agent architecture that breaks queries into structured sub-problems, performs hybrid dense/sparse search in Qdrant, and cross-reranks before LLM synthesis.
items.architectureFlow: Query -> Agentic Router -> [Sub-Queries] -> (Qdrant Dense + BM25) -> Reciprocal Rank Fusion -> Cross-Encoder -> LLM Inference -> Grounded Response
items.security: Prompt Injection Guardrails, Tool-calling Authorization & Strict Data Isolation

items.title: MLOps-Pipeline-Suite
items.subtitle: End-to-End ML Model Lifecycle & Production Deployment
items.challenge: ML prototypes frequently stall before production due to missing data versioning, unmonitored model degradation, and high-risk manual deployments.
items.solution: Automated retraining pipeline with drift detection via Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistical tests, DVC data versioning, MLflow registry, and canary rollouts on Kubernetes.
items.architectureFlow: Data Ingest -> Drift Detector -> DVC Snapshot -> PyTorch Retraining -> MLflow Registry -> K8s Canary Deploy -> Prometheus Monitoring
items.evaluation: Drift Trigger Accuracy: 100% | Canary Deployment P99 < 50ms
items.security: Role-Based Model Promotion & Cryptographic Artifact Signatures

items.title: Control-AI-Optimizer
items.subtitle: Physics-Informed Neural Network for Real-Time Control Loops
items.challenge: Standard PID controllers degrade under severe non-linear disturbances, while purely neural controllers lack formal stability guarantees.
items.solution: Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) acting as a residual error compensator on top of a classic control loop, subject to deterministic Lyapunov stability bounds.
items.architectureFlow: Sensors -> Kalman Filter -> Classic PID + [PINN Residual Corrector] -> Lyapunov Barrier -> Control Signal -> Physical Plant
items.evaluation: Settling Time Reduction: -38% | Stability Boundary Violations: 0%
items.security: Deterministic Lyapunov Guardian overriding out-of-bound neural outputs

items.title: Local-AI-Agent-Terminal
items.subtitle: 100% Offline & Private AI Coding Assistant CLI
items.challenge: Cloud-based AI assistants violate data privacy constraints in sensitive environments and introduce network latency bottlenecks.
items.solution: Autonomous terminal tool running local models via Ollama, parsing repository AST structures with Tree-sitter, and applying diffs inside a secure sandbox.
items.architectureFlow: Prompt -> AST Parser (Tree-sitter) -> Symbol Graph -> Context Memory -> Local LLM (Ollama) -> Sandbox Apply -> Git Check
items.evaluation: AST Parse Latency: < 8ms | Context Precision: 94% | 100% Offline
items.security: Sandboxed File Operations with No External Network Calls & AST Boundary
